title: Carry forward only the relevant evidence
text: Why did that happen, and what should we check next?
task_summary: Earlier turns: the synthetic API release was followed by increased service errors at 11:05 UTC. Explain the cause only if supported by evidence.

sources.body: The new API contract made account_ref required; some clients were not updated.
At 11:05 UTC, requests without account_ref began failing with HTTP 422.
The synthetic API deployment completed at 11:04 UTC.

lesson: A follow-up is not an excuse to resend the whole history. The host still needs evidence-completeness checks.
